description: Make Daytona the Default Sandbox Backend - Remove StoreBackend routes from all execution paths, simplify resolve_sandbox_backend() to no longer accept routes param, let Daytona handle everything

userStories.title: Remove StoreBackend routes from resolve_sandbox_backend() and all callers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the predefined StoreBackend routes dict from all 3 execution paths and from resolve_sandbox_backend() so that Daytona handles all operations without route overrides.
acceptanceCriteria: resolve_sandbox_backend() in backend/src/agents/__init__.py no longer accepts a routes parameter
resolve_sandbox_backend() signature becomes: resolve_sandbox_backend(runtime: ToolRuntime) -> tuple[CompositeBackend, Any]
When Daytona is capable: returns CompositeBackend with daytona_backend as default and NO StoreBackend routes
When Daytona fallback: returns CompositeBackend with StateBackend as default and NO StoreBackend routes
StoreBackend import and store_backend = StoreBackend(runtime) removed from backend/src/controllers/llm.py
StoreBackend import and store_backend = StoreBackend(runtime) removed from backend/src/utils/stream.py
StoreBackend import and store_backend = StoreBackend(runtime) removed from backend/src/workers/tasks.py
The routes = { f'/users/{user_id}/memories/': ..., f'/users/{user_id}/config/': ... } dict removed from all 3 callers
All 3 callers now call resolve_sandbox_backend(runtime) with no routes kwarg
userStories.notes: Current state: resolve_sandbox_backend(runtime, *, routes) at line 267 of __init__.py. 3 callers: llm.py:122, stream.py:224, tasks.py:237. Each creates identical routes dict with StoreBackend for /memories/ and /config/ paths. Remove all of this. The fallback path in resolve_sandbox_backend currently iterates routes and builds built_routes — remove that logic too.

userStories.title: Update unit tests for routeless resolve_sandbox_backend()
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the test suite updated to reflect that resolve_sandbox_backend() no longer takes routes and StoreBackend is no longer used in execution paths.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/tests/unit/agents/test_daytona.py: All resolve_sandbox_backend() tests updated to call without routes param
backend/tests/unit/agents/test_daytona.py: Remove any tests that assert StoreBackend route construction (callable route factories, non-callable routes)
backend/tests/unit/agents/test_daytona.py: Daytona success path test asserts CompositeBackend has no StoreBackend routes
backend/tests/unit/agents/test_daytona.py: Fallback path test asserts CompositeBackend has no StoreBackend routes
No test files reference StoreBackend in the context of resolve_sandbox_backend or execution path routing
cd frontend && npm run test passes
userStories.notes: Current test file: backend/tests/unit/agents/test_daytona.py has TestResolveSandboxBackend with 7 tests including 'callable route factories invoked' and 'non-callable routes used directly' — these must be removed or rewritten since routes param is gone.
